finalText:
Fixed. Two root causes:

- `src/length.js` / `src/truncate.js` counted and sliced UTF-16 units, splitting surrogate pairs (the lone `\ud83c`). Now they operate on code points via `[...string]`.
- `src/slug.js` ran its drop regex before normalizing, so combining marks (`U+0300`, etc.) were deleted. It now `.normalize('NFC')` first, composing accents so they survive and canonical equivalents produce identical slugs.
